command: Connect the approved one-outstanding 24-bit-index/128-bit-record descriptor port to one read lane of shared_l2_macro_fabric with descriptor_base+index*16 lane extraction; test response/error/backpressure and coexistence with the second read client and writes. Continue extending the same production sequencer beyond the passing single-tile OS GEMM subset. Run every build/test with taskset -c 8-25, at most j4, only when MemAvailable exceeds 10 GiB.
success_condition: Descriptor records are returned from the real 16-ARM-macro Shared-L2 path with exact lane/address mapping; randomized read/write contention has zero mismatch/loss/duplication/timeout, and no CUSTOM_3 command issues before all required descriptor chains validate.
failure_policy: Stop at the first protocol/numerical mismatch. Do not bypass Shared L2, substitute pre-lowered host micro-ops, use io_resp as completion, loosen descriptor legality, or mark L2/L3 PASS before their remaining canonical gates close. Do not run Library Compiler or LEF generation while deferred by the user.
